what: Gate A/B/C prose is absent from the proposed amendment sites

what: Plan-review prompt changes target the wrong rendered surface
scenario_or_breakage: The plan updates plan-review.md, but static reviewer prompts are hardcoded by render-plan-review-prompt.sh and dynamic prompts append that renderer tail; reviewer outputs will not receive the readability preamble unless the renderer itself reads/substitutes it
suggested_fix: Amend render-plan-review-prompt.sh to load readability-style.md and emit the concrete style text in the rendered prompt, then update test-plan-review-prompt.sh to assert the rendered prompt contains it and no literal <READABILITY_STYLE>
